description: LoginScreen UI composition final pass - viewport redesign with 40% hero, 30% brand, 30% auth sections, plus premium Cover Flow refinement
steps: Step 1 - Adjust carousel height to 40% viewport: Change CAROUSEL_HEIGHT from SCREEN_HEIGHT * 0.42 to SCREEN_HEIGHT * 0.40. This is already close but ensure it is exactly 0.40.

Step 2 - Warm white to cream gradient background: The background is currently '#FFFBF5' with a background image. Since expo-linear-gradient is not available, simulate the gradient using a layered approach: keep the root background as '#FFFBF5' (warm white), add a second View positioned absolutely at the bottom 60% with backgroundColor '#FFF8F0' (cream) and opacity 0.5. This creates a subtle warm-to-cream transition.

Step 3 - Cover Flow refinement: Increase CAROUSEL_ITEM_WIDTH to SCREEN_WIDTH * 0.62, keep 4:3 ratio. Increase border radius to 24. Increase border width to 2.5. Adjust SIDE_TRANSLATE_X to CAROUSEL_ITEM_WIDTH * 0.38 for better overlap. Increase shadow depth: shadowOffset height to 16, shadowOpacity to 0.30, shadowRadius to 24, elevation to 18. Increase perspective to 1200. The goal is premium floating depth with Apple Cover Flow feel.
Step 4 - Brand section typography hierarchy: Increase brandName fontSize to 28. Change tagline letterSpacing to 2.0 for more premium feel. Keep brandDescription but reduce paddingHorizontal to 16.

Step 5 - Statistics cards refinement: Increase statCard paddingVertical to 10, paddingHorizontal to 16, minWidth to 90. Increase shadow: shadowOffset height to 5, shadowOpacity to 0.12, shadowRadius to 12, elevation to 5. This makes the cards more prominent and premium.

Step 6 - Auth section spacing: Reduce marginBottom between buttons from 8 to 10 for the primary button. Ensure the orDivider has marginVertical of 10 (not just marginBottom). Ensure guestButton has paddingVertical of 10.
Step 7 - Terms of Service links: Already implemented with red accent color and CmsPage navigation. Verify they use lightColors.accent (#FF3B30) for the link text. Already done in current code.
Step 8 - Dev login positioning: The devLoginContainer has marginTop: 60 which pushes it below the fold on scroll. This is correct. Keep as-is.
acceptance_criteria: Carousel occupies approximately 40% of viewport height
Background has a subtle warm-to-cream gradient effect
Cover Flow items have larger radius (24), deeper shadows, and premium floating feel
Brand section has clear typography hierarchy
Statistics cards have enhanced shadows and spacing
Auth buttons are well-spaced with clear visual separation
verification: Review LoginScreen.tsx stylesheet values match the specified dimensions
Confirm no functional changes to auth logic
findings: All styling changes applied successfully. Cannot run tsc due to INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network but verified balanced braces/parens/brackets via Python script. Changes are purely numerical style adjustments and one new View + style addition - no functional code modified.
